scripts.dev:phone: node scripts/toggleLiveReload.js on && adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 && vite
scripts.build:apk: node scripts/toggleLiveReload.js off && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd ..
scripts.install:phone: adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n com.drumtuner.tunebot/.MainActivity

scripts.cap:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android
